disclaimer.title: About this estimate
disclaimer.short: An estimate, not a quotation. Availability can change the total, flights to Egypt are not included, and a travel specialist confirms the final figure.
disclaimer.estimate: This is an estimate, not a quotation, built from indicative rates.
disclaimer.availability: Availability, season and room type can change the total.
disclaimer.flights: Flights to and from Egypt are not included.
disclaimer.specialist: A travel specialist confirms the final quotation before anything is booked.

rules.title: How this is calculated
rules.accommodation: A room for every night but the last, at the chosen level's rate for that place. {{perRoom}} people to a room. The nights a cruise cabin or a desert camp already covers are not charged.
rules.experiences: Each experience at its per-person price, for every adult on the trip.
rules.children: Under {{childAge}}. A child pays {{childRate}} of the adult price on each experience, and nothing on one with a minimum age they do not meet. Children count towards rooms.
rules.private: Adds each experience's private supplement per person, on the experiences that offer a private option. The others stay shared.
rules.transport: The quickest transfer between each pair of places on the route, per traveller. Anything without a direct link routes through a hub city such as Cairo.
rules.fee: {{rate}} of experiences and transport, never of accommodation. Optional: without it, you get the bare cost and no specialist.
rules.perTraveller: The total divided equally. The adult and child figures split rooms, transfers and the fee equally and charge each person their own experiences.
rules.currency: Everything is priced in US dollars and shown in your currency at an indicative rate, rounded to whole units.

page.requestHint: No payment. A travel specialist replies within one working day.
page.daysHint: The same estimate, laid out by day. A transfer is charged on the day it happens; a hotel night on the day it begins.
page.tableNote: The subtotal is before planning and support. The last day carries no hotel night: it is the journey home.

preferences.title: Anything we should know?
preferences.hint: All of this is optional. It goes to the specialist with your itinerary, so it shapes the quotation rather than being asked for afterwards.
preferences.accessibilityHint: Steps, distances, heat, a wheelchair, anything that changes which days work. Several sites have uneven ground.
preferences.transferYesHint: A driver meets you at arrivals.

send.title: Check and send
send.hint: One last look. Sending creates a request, not a booking: nothing is charged and nothing is held until you say so.
send.consent: I agree to being contacted about this request and have read the
send.consentRequired: Please tick the box so we may reply to you.
send.failed: The request could not be saved. Nothing was sent. Please try again in a moment.
send.failedNetwork: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again; your details are still here.
send.failedInvalid: Something in the {{field}} was not accepted. Please check it and try again.
send.whatHappens: When you send, the itinerary, the estimate and your details go to a travel specialist. You receive a booking reference straight away and a reply within one working day.
send.failedRate: Too many requests from this connection in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again; your details are still here.

summary.title: What you are sending
summary.note: An estimate, not a quotation. Flights to Egypt are not included. A specialist confirms the final figure.

confirmation.referenceHint: Quote it if you write to us. A copy of everything below stays in this browser, and this page can be printed or saved as a PDF.
confirmation.thanks: Thank you, {{name}}. Your request has reached us and a travel specialist has it.
confirmation.thanksNoName: The request has reached us and a travel specialist has it.
confirmation.responseBody: You will hear from us within one working day.

steps.check: A specialist checks availability for your dates: rooms, cabins, guides and the transfers between places.
steps.quote: You receive a written quotation. Where something is unavailable or could be better, it says so and offers an alternative.
steps.confirm: Only when you are happy do you confirm. A deposit secures the booking; nothing is charged before then.

confirmation.keepBody: Your trip stays in this browser, so you can keep looking at it, or start another one. The estimate you sent is the one we quote against.
confirmation.notFoundTitle: We could not find that request
confirmation.notFoundBody: Check the reference in the link. If you sent the request from another browser, the copy with your details is there; this one can only show requests it knows about or can look up.
confirmation.forget: Forget this request on this device
confirmation.forgetHint: Removes the copy with your contact details from this browser. The request itself stays with us.
